_what: Every rule the fleet table applies, in one place. Written for the S47 audit (2026-10-26) before its results were read, with ONE post-hoc alias (A73 'GKM' -> MaStR station 'Grosskraftwerk Mannheim'), which is marked. fleet_table.py reads this file and nothing else for its parameters.
_min_net_mw: MaStR units below 10 MW net are not in the register extract (extract_mastr.py)
_r_km: a station row claims the register units of a compatible family within 2 km of its coordinate
_site_km: a name match must lie within 5 km; a station row with no unit at 2 km may take, by its own name or as the only claimant, units within 5 km
_cap_tol: a unit row (BNA number) that MaStR does not number is identified by one MaStR unit of a compatible family within 2 km whose net MW is within 15% of the row's
_a73_market_cf: a unit whose own A73 2025 output is at least a 10% capacity factor ran in the market in 2025, whatever its later status
_bna_row_pattern: inventory rows named like this are unit rows of the BNetzA list (via OPSD). Note: OPSD writes one id as 'BNa1947' (13.6 MW); the pattern reads it as a station row. Kept for parity with the audit.
_mastr_family: storage units: 'Pumpspeicher' -> psp, all others -> battery (dropped)
_opsd_family: technology containing 'Pumped storage' -> psp; anything unlisted -> other
_compatible: inventory family -> register families it may claim. 'heat' for gas: a CCGT's steam turbine is registered as a 'Wärme' unit (DT HKW-Niehl-2).
_a73_alias: POST-HOC, the only one: A73 publishes Mannheim as 'GKM AG <TSO>'; no MaStR text carries 'GKM'.
name_stopwords: kraftwerk kraftwerke heizkraftwerk heizkraftwerks gasturbine gasturbinen block bloc werk werke power station plant unit anlage anlagen gmbh mbh kg co ag und der die das des the gud stadtwerke energie energy versorgung erzeugung fernwaerme fernwaermekraftwerk gasturbinenkraftwerk nord sued west ost mitte neu standort betrieb dampfkraftwerk heizwerk generator turbine motor gaskraftwerk kohlekraftwerk braunkohlekraftwerk steinkohlekraftwerk wasserkraftwerk pumpspeicherwerk pumpspeicherkraftwerk speicherkraftwerk natural blockheizkraftwerk anlagenkonto industriekraftwerk gemeinschaftskraftwerk
_name_tokens: a name token is a lower-cased, accent-folded word of >= 4 letters, not all digits, not a stopword
_class_order_for_station_rows: a station row stands for the live units of its site first; what it cannot stand for is no_register_row, except on a site whose units a unit row already carries, where the remainder is the double count (duplicate)
unit_class_2025: not_yet: commissioned after 2025, or MaStR 'In Planung'
closed_pre_2025: MaStR final closure before 2025-01-01 (an OPSD-only unit: OPSD 2020 status shutdown with shutdown year <= 2024; a Kraftwerksliste closure year <= 2024)
out_2025: grid reserve per the Verfahrensliste (>= half of 2025) AND a Kraftwerksliste reserve status
market / out_2025: MaStR final or temporary closure during 2025 -> market if in the second half, out_2025 if in the first
out_2025: Kraftwerksliste status reserve or temporarily closed, or closure year 2025
unknown_2025: an OPSD-only unit operating in 2020 with no later register row

verfahrensliste_2025_03_10._source: BNetzA BK8, Verfahrensliste inländische Netzreserve, Stand 10.03.2025 (PDF, sha256 in MANIFEST.json). Transcribed by hand: plant -> designation periods; the MaStR unit numbers were found by hand (S47 Part A.1). 'Heizkraftwerk Magirusstraße – Kohleblock' (designation ended 2022) and 'Altbach HKW 2 (DT und GT E)' (Kraftwerksliste: InBetrieb) are listed without units: a designation as system-relevant is not a reserve operation.
